chapter_title: Concerning the Four Archetypes that occur in the E
spiritual_reading:
#
 Spiritual
 Translation


**
¶1:**

There are four fac
ulties of interior
 perception within
 the human spirit
, by
 which it
 app
rehends spiritual
 realities.
 Without
 these four capac
ities —
 conce
aled within the very
 structure
 of the mind
 — no genuine
 understanding
 of
 what
 is Divine
 is possible;
 they
 belong
 to the in
most life
 itself
.

**¶2:**

The will
 in
 its corru
pted state —
 the
 heat
 of self-love — belongs to the
 consuming
 love
 of self
.
 Falsity belongs to the deepest spiritual
 void,
 the
 abyss where
 no
 truth
 penet
rates. But wisdom
 — the Divine
 truth that perceives what lies
 hidden within all these dark
ened states — being
 pure and uncorrupted in
 itself
, is the living understanding that proceeds from
 the Lord
:
 the
 very
 breath
 of spiritual
 life through
 which the mind
 receives infl
ux from above
.

**¶3:**

*
Much
 of
 this passage
 res
ists confident
 translation due
 to frag
mentation;
 what
 follows
 is my
 best reading of
 the surviving
 structure
.*

The in
most faculty
 of understanding shall
 not remain
 closed
 to the interior
 truth;
 the
 passage
 between
 natural
 and spiritual perception is
 the gateway
 through which infl
ux desc
ends into
 all
 the surrounding
 states of
 the
 mind —
 the whole
 compass of spiritual life. For
 in the celest
ial degree
, which
 is above
 and
 in
most
, the Divine itself
 dwells.
 From
 that
 highest
 state
,
 living
 per
ceptions descended
 into lower
 degrees of
 the
 mind.
 The prim
ordial celest
ial humanity
 —
 the Most Ancient perception
 of
 the Divine
 — proceeded
 forth
 from that
 wisdom and possessed universal knowledge
 of all spiritual realities:
 an
 un
med
iated perception
 in
 which no
 truth was hidden
 and
 no correspondence
 was op
aque.

---


*
Note on
 "
living air"
 (
¶2): Air
 corresponds
 in
 Swedenborg to the spiritual atmosphere
 of
 thought
 and
 understanding;
 "
living air" thus
 renders
 as
 the
 living understanding that flows
 from the Divine —
 equivalent
 to the spirit
 or
 breath of life
 that
 animates all
 true
 perception
.
 This
 al
igns closely
 with the Manichaean identification
 of Living
 Spirit
 as
 the resc
uing
 divine
 intell
ect.*

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: There are four aspects among mankind that perceive, as they perceive [the mysteries of all things;] without these four that are hidden in them [there is no knowledge of the Divine, for] they belong [to the inmost life of the soul]. So, [these four are the foundations of all understanding].
[The heat of desire] that is in the [heart] belongs to the fire. The Darkness belongs to the abyss; but the Light that perceives what is hidden in all these things, being clear, is the Living Air.

The pupil of the
 eye shall not [be closed to]
 the mystery of the [Light, which
] is the door [that opens from
] below [upon] the other four
 cardinal points. For in the [height
 is the Father] above. He has
 [revealed his] great [glory,
 and] they came down [as]
 living [spirits]. The First Man came
 forth from it and knew all things.
